name: Form Builder, Quiz, Survey and Form Analytics with Leads Redirection System – SimpleForm
author: wpazleen

sections.description:
Simple Form is a modern and flexible WordPress Form Builder Plugin that allows you to easily create
📩 Contact Forms,
📝 Quizzes, Polls & Surveys,
🔐 Login & Registration Forms,
💬 Comment Forms – all in just a few clicks!

With its drag-and-drop interface, you can build attractive and professional forms, quizzes, and online exams without writing a single line of code.

🚀 Simple Form | 📖 Documentation | 💬 Pro Support

Let’s grow, connect, and build together! 🚀

  • 🤝 Join our community on Facebook: Facebook

  • 🎥 Subscribe to our YouTube channel: YouTube

  • 🐦 Follow us on X (Twitter): X / Twitter

🌟 Why Choose Simple Form?

✅ Quiz & Survey Maker
Create quizzes, surveys, and online exams quickly using simple steps — perfect for educational institutions, businesses, and lead generation.

✅ Conditional Logic & Multi-Step Forms
Automatically change form questions and steps based on user input for a smarter user experience.

✅ Analytics & Lead Management
Track responses, analyze data, and manage leads from one central dashboard.

✅ Smart Notification & Redirection System
Send instant notifications when specific events occur on your website via
📢 Slack,
✉️ Mail,
📱 WhatsApp,
✈️ Telegram
— to channels, groups, or individual users.

✅ Powerful Integrations
Easily connect with other tools and services to make your workflow more efficient and automated.

Form creation, quiz and survey management, user interaction, automated notifications, and data analytics — everything you need in one powerful plugin: Simple Form.

👉 Make your WordPress website smarter, more interactive, and conversion-focused with Simple Form today.

Key Features

Simple Form includes comprehensive tools for creating and managing:

  • 📩 Contact Forms for communication, inquiries, and feedback
  • 🧠 Quiz Builder with scoring, images, and detailed result options
  • 📊 Poll Creator with real-time results and analytics
  • 🔐 Login & Registration Forms for WordPress and WooCommerce
  • 💬 Comment Form Customization
  • 🧩 Multi-Step Forms for improved user experience
  • 🔀 Conditional Logic based on user input
  • 📈 Form Analytics & Tracking
  • 🔗 Integrations with Mailchimp, Google Sheets, Trello, WhatsApp, Telegram, and Slack
  • 🧲 Lead Management System
  • 🎨 Built-in Themes & Custom Theme Options
  • 📌 Floating Form Placements

Quiz Builder

Create engaging quizzes with advanced configuration options:

  • Multiple question types
  • Scoring and pass/fail rules
  • Question and answer randomization
  • Image-based questions and answers
  • Time limits for quizzes
  • Detailed analytics and result summaries

Shortcode:
[simple_quiz id=”1″]

Perfect for online exams, education platforms, assessments, and lead engagement.

Poll Creator

Create interactive polls with flexible display and control options:

  • Single or multiple-choice polls
  • Image-based answers
  • Result visibility control
  • Poll closing dates
  • Login-required voting
  • Revote control
  • Dedicated analytics dashboard

Shortcode:
[simple_poll id=”1″]

Ideal for surveys, community engagement, and real-time audience feedback.

Authentication Forms

Replace default WordPress authentication forms with fully customizable versions:

  • Custom login form
  • Custom registration form
  • Additional custom fields
  • Redirect rules after login/registration
  • Email verification support
  • Comment form customization

All authentication options can be configured under:
Settings > Auth Settings

Form Themes & Design

Choose from multiple built-in themes or design your own custom look. Available styles include:

  • Modern
  • Minimalist
  • Neomorphic
  • Glassmorphism
  • And more

Create visually stunning forms that perfectly match your website’s branding.

Integrations

Email Notifications

  • Send structured form notifications
  • Support multiple recipients

Mailchimp

  • Automatically add subscribers
  • Custom field mapping

Google Sheets

  • Sync form submissions in real time
  • Custom column mapping

Trello

  • Automatically create cards from submissions

WhatsApp

  • Redirect users with pre-filled messages

Telegram

  • Send submissions to channels or groups

Slack

  • Receive real-time notifications instantly

Form Analytics & Tracking

Gain valuable insights with detailed analytics, including:

  • Total views and submissions
  • Success and error logs
  • Redirect paths
  • Time-based performance tracking
  • Conversion metrics

Lead Management

Manage and organize leads efficiently with:

  • Date filtering (today, yesterday, last week, last month, custom range)
  • Search and sorting options
  • Export data as CSV, JSON, PDF, or print
  • Single or bulk deletion

Say goodbye to form building frustrations and hello to Simple Form form builder. Create, collect, and conquer with the ultimate form-building solution. Download now and see for yourself why “Simple Form” is the preferred choice for savvy website owners like you. Simplify, collect, and thrive with SimpleForm.
Get started with Simple Form today and transform your website’s form experience!

🔥 More Awesome Plugins

If you enjoy SimpleForm, you ought to take a look at our other great projects:
🤖 Activity Guard – Real-Time System & User Activity Logs, Forum Tracker and Security Plugin
Activity Guard is the Ultimate WordPress activity log plugin for tracking user actions, monitoring WooCommerce events, and securing your site in real-time. With instant notifications via Slack and email, it empowers admins to respond quickly to critical events and ensure site security.

How to Use

After activating the plugin navigate to your Admin Dashboard > SimpleForm > Form and from there build your required form using drag and drop. Next save it with any form name.
You will then automatically be redirected to the “Data” page, from there you can edit your form or create a form on any of your pages or posts using the shortcode.
sections.installation:
1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Simple Form”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”
sections.faq:
Is Simple Form really free?

A: Yes! Simple Form offers powerful features completely free, including form builder, quiz builder, poll creator, analytics, integrations, and more. We also have a Pro version with additional advanced features.

Do I need coding knowledge to use Simple Form?

A: No! Simple Form features an intuitive drag-and-drop interface. Anyone can create professional forms, quizzes, and polls without writing a single line of code.

What types of forms can I create?

A: You can create any type of form including contact forms, registration forms, survey forms, order forms, feedback forms, quote request forms, and more.

Can I create multi-step forms?

A: Yes! Add page breaks to your form and enable progress indicators to create beautiful multi-step forms with visual progress tracking.

Can I add conditional logic to my forms?

A: Absolutely! Enable conditional logic on any field to show/hide fields or change values based on user input.

How do I create a quiz?

A: Navigate to Quizzes in the Simple Form menu, click “Create Quiz,” add your questions and answers, mark correct answers, configure settings, and save. Use the shortcode [simple_quiz id="X"] to display it.

Can I add images to quiz questions?

A: Yes! You can add images to both questions and answer options for more engaging quizzes.

How do polls work?

A: Create a poll with multiple answer options, configure settings (single/multiple choice, show results, etc.), and embed using [simple_poll id="X"]. Users vote and can see results based on your settings.

Can I limit quiz time?

A: Yes! Set a time limit in quiz settings to create timed quizzes.

Which integrations are available?

A: Simple Form integrates with Mailchimp, Google Sheets, Trello, WhatsApp, Telegram, Slack, and email notifications.

How do I connect to Mailchimp?

A: Go to Integrations > Mailchimp, enter your API key, select your list, map form fields, and save. Form submissions will automatically sync to Mailchimp.

Can I send form data to Google Sheets?

A: Yes! Connect your Google account in Integrations > Google Sheets, select your spreadsheet, and map form fields to columns.

Does WhatsApp integration work on mobile?

A: Yes! The WhatsApp integration works seamlessly on both desktop and mobile devices.

Can I replace the WordPress login form?

A: Yes! Go to Settings > Auth Settings, create a custom login form, and enable “Replace WordPress Login Form.”

Will replacing forms break my site?

A: No! Simple Form safely replaces forms while maintaining all WordPress functionality. You can disable replacements anytime.

Can I customize WooCommerce forms?

A: Yes! Create custom WooCommerce login and registration forms in Auth Settings.

What analytics are tracked?

A: Simple Form tracks views, submissions, success rate, conversion rate, errors, and redirects for each form.

Can I export form submissions?

A: Yes! Export leads in CSV, JSON, or PDF format, or print them directly from the Leads page.

How do I filter leads by date?

A: Use the date filter on the Leads page to view submissions from today, yesterday, last week, last month, or a custom date range.

What is the notification ball?

A: The notification ball appears when new forms are submitted, allowing you to quickly view and manage new leads.

What Makes Simple Form Unique

  1. All-in-One Solution – Forms, quizzes, polls, login forms, and more in one plugin
  2. Generous Free Version – Advanced features that others charge for
  3. Modern Interface – Beautiful, intuitive design that’s easy to use
  4. Performance Optimized – Fast loading, clean code, efficient database queries
  5. Regular Updates – Constantly improving with new features and fixes
  6. Excellent Support – Responsive support team ready to help
  7. Active Development – New features added regularly based on user feedback
